meta.name: elevenlabs-stt
meta.description: ElevenLabs speech-to-text with Scribe models and forced alignment via inference.sh CLI. Models: Scribe v1/v2 (98%+ accuracy, 90+ languages). Capabilities: transcription, speaker diarization, audio event tagging, word-level timestamps, forced alignment, subtitle generation. Use for: meeting transcription, subtitles, podcast transcripts, lip-sync timing, karaoke. Triggers: elevenlabs stt, elevenlabs transcription, scribe, elevenlabs speech to text, forced alignment, word alignment, subtitle timing, diarization, speaker identification, audio event detection, eleven labs transcribe

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将语音转为带时间戳的文字和字幕
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将音频或视频中的语音转成文字并生成字幕。
copy.tagline_en: Convert speech to text with timestamps and subtitles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to transcribe audio or video into text with timestamps and generate subtitles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能转录音频为文字，支持90多种语言，可区分说话人、标记笑声等事件，还能将已知文本与音频对齐生成逐字时间戳。
howto.when: 当你提到“elevenlabs stt”、“转录”、“强制对齐”等关键词，或要求处理音频转文字、生成字幕时触发。

say.text: 帮我转录这段会议录音，并区分说话人。
say.note: 会调用转录并启用说话人识别。

say.text: 用强制对齐功能，把这段字幕文本对齐到音频。
say.note: 会运行强制对齐，返回逐字时间戳。

say.text: 转录这个播客，并标记笑声和掌声。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can transcribe audio to text in 90+ languages, identify speakers, tag audio events like laughter, and align known text to audio for word-level timestamps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "elevenlabs stt", "transcription", "forced alignment", or ask to transcribe audio or generate subtitles.

say_en.text: Transcribe this meeting recording and identify speakers.
Use forced alignment to align this subtitle text to the audio.
say_en.note: Runs forced alignment, returns word timestamps.

say_en.text: Transcribe this podcast and tag laughter and applause.
